subject: general
question: Which of the following initiative was launched on 21 March 2025, by the Ministry of Science and Technology to offer structured biotech mentorship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BioSaarthi Mentorship Initiative**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **BioSaarthi Mentorship Initiative** was officially launched on **21 March 2025** by the **Union Ministry of Science and Technology**. It is designed to act as a catalyst for the burgeoning biotechnology ecosystem in India.
 
• The primary objective of this initiative is to provide **structured mentorship** to **biotech startups**, **early-stage researchers**, and **students**, ensuring they receive professional guidance from established industry veterans and renowned academicians.
 
• By creating a bridge between **academia and industry**, the program seeks to facilitate the transition of **innovative lab-scale research** into **commercialized products** and scalable business models.
 
• The initiative emphasizes **inclusive growth**, specifically targeting innovators in **Tier-II and Tier-III cities** who often lack access to high-level strategic and technical networks found in major metropolitan hubs.
 
• The **BioSaarthi** platform offers guidance on several critical aspects, including **Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)** management, **regulatory compliance**, and **clinical trial strategies**. ***Hence, the correct answer is the BioSaarthi Mentorship Initiative.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC):**
 
 
• **BIRAC** is a **Section 8**, **Not-for-Profit Public Sector Enterprise**, set up by the **Department of Biotechnology (DBT)** to empower the emerging biotech enterprise.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in implementing schemes like **BioSaarthi** to bridge the gap between **industry and academia**.
 
• The organization provides funding, infrastructure, and **incubation support** to startups through various programs like the **Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)**.
 
 
 
• **India's Bioeconomy Goals:**
 
 
• India aims to reach a **Bioeconomy** valuation of **$300 billion** by the **year 2030**, contributing significantly to the **$5 trillion economy** vision.
 
• The **Department of Biotechnology** focuses on sectors such as **Biopharma**, **Bio-agriculture**, and **Bio-industrial** applications to drive this growth.
 
• In **2024-25**, the focus intensified on **Deep Tech** and **Synthetic Biology** to ensure global competitiveness.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Department of Biotechnology (DBT):** Established in **1986**, it is the nodal agency under the **Ministry of Science and Technology** responsible for the development of modern biology and biotechnology in **India**.
 
• **Global Standing:** India is currently ranked among the **top 12 biotechnology destinations** in the world and holds the **3rd position** in the **Asia-Pacific** region.
 
• **Focus on Startups:** The number of biotech startups in India has grown from a few hundred in **2014** to over **6,000** by **2024**, necessitating initiatives like **BioSaarthi** for high-quality technical **mentorship**.
 
• **Sectors Covered:** The mentorship covers diverse fields including **Genomics**, **Vaccine Development**, **Bio-informatics**, and **Precision Medicine**.
